title: Count Length-K Windows Above Average Threshold
description: Given an integer array `nums`, positive window length `k`, and integer `threshold`, count contiguous windows of exactly `k` elements whose average is at least `threshold`. Compare using the exact sum, without rounding. Input: `nums`, `k`, `threshold`. Output: the number of qualifying windows.
hints: Track the running prefix, window, or frequency information needed by the condition.
Check duplicates, all-equal values, and boundary-sized windows.
